ONNX Runtime 1.32.0 C API headers (Microsoft, MIT licence - see LICENSE.txt).
The matching onnxruntime.dll comes from the official NuGet package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime 1.32.0;
build.ps1 downloads it into %USERPROFILE%\CINEMAX-dev\deps and copies it next to CINEMAX.exe.
Used only by the optional webcam head tracker, loaded at run time (LoadLibrary).
